title: Make multi-item reservations atomic
prompt: Inventory#reserve can reduce stock for early items before a later item fails. Make reservation atomic: if any requested SKU is missing, insufficient, or has a non-positive quantity, no stock count may change. Keep the public reserve and available methods, preserve the existing error for insufficient stock, add clear errors for invalid quantities, and add focused tests.

workflows: apply all stock decrements only after validation
concepts: missing SKU has zero available stock
invariants: a failed reservation leaves every stock count unchanged
defect_probes: failure after an earlier valid SKU
rubric.impact_question: If reserve later needs a dry-run mode that validates without decrementing stock, where should it be added and which invariant must remain shared with normal reservation?
accepted_alternatives: apply changes to a temporary stock copy and commit only after success

runtime_only_if_observed: why one atomicity strategy was rejected in favor of another
